title: Packet Loss - An IT text adventure game
author: Zenpher
selftext:
Hey everyone! I’m working on **Packet Loss**, a text-based adventure where you try to keep a dysfunctional company’s IT running without losing your job (or your sanity).

You’ll fix tickets, deal with questionable management decisions, get to know your coworkers, and occasionally trust the junior tech with something important. Results may vary.

It’s definitely a niche game, but I’d love some honest feedback, especially on what would make it more fun. Are the choices interesting? Does anything feel repetitive or frustrating? Is it actually funny?

https://preview.redd.it/kt9aofgrztnh1.png?width=1449&format=png&auto=webp&s=874e884299b9342055b713abfac8db3022c7de09

You can play it here: [**https://packet-loss.vercel.app/**](https://packet-loss.vercel.app/)

Even a few minutes of playing and a “this bit was annoying” would help. Thanks!

comments.author: TheNomad456
comments.body: Damn, I love this game. This is so fun.

replies.author: Zenpher
replies.body:
Did you end up finishing the month? Let me know if you have some feedback :)

I'm planning on changing a few systems, especially around your early decisions snowballing into bigger events.

replies.author: TheNomad456
replies.body: I just finished the first week and I'm laughing a lot, especially that I have some experience in the field. The design is really appealing and the jokes are funny. Overall, this is a great game. Are you planning on releasing it for mobile, too? Like a downloadable content?

replies.author: Zenpher
replies.body:
Well I'm glad that you're enjoying it! I'm in the industry and a lot of the jokes are from real life anecdotes.

If you have Windows, I've released it to the MS Store (free for a limited time): https://apps.microsoft.com/store/detail/9P3QMG661Q0P

I wasn't really thinking about mobile but that's actually a great idea. Thank you.
